mechanism: Beta-lactam antibiotics can reduce gentamicin efficacy against certain organisms and increase nephrotoxicity risk, particularly in renal impairment; synergistic activity may also occur against some gram-positive bacteria.
action: Monitor renal function, serum creatinine, and gentamicin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider dosing interval adjustments based on renal function; combination is often intentional for synergy but requires careful monitoring.
